My plot is big — over thirteen hectares — and I grow mixed crops together to spread my risk. Near Dar es Salaam the markets are close, so I try to put some money into the land, but fertilizer is expensive and I cannot cover every hectare the same way. I will buy a little chemical fertilizer for the parts that need it most, and I use the manure from my animals and household waste where I can. With a plot this size my family cannot do everything alone, so I will hire people for planting and harvest, but I do not have pumps or channels to irrigate all of it — we depend on the rains.
